name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 25 – Am 15
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 25. Recalls that disproportionate measures on pricing and excise duties on tobacco and nicotine products that do not adequately reflect differences between product categories and their risk profiles may encourage consumers to turn to the black market, hence risking the consumption of fraudulent and unsafe products; stresses the need to assess and monitor the potential impact of such measures on illicit trade and black market activities, both during their design and following their implementation, while respecting Member States’ competences in taxation and the applicable EU legal framework;
